tracks.title: Mass Tree Plantation
tracks.summary: Ridge-to-village planting crews that stay through the first two monsoons, not just the photo hour.
tracks.details: Stewards mark pits, record the sapling, and check survival at 90 and 365 days. A dead sapling does not stay on the ledger. Schools, panchayat grounds, and degraded grazing edges are the first sites.

tracks.title: Blue Water Mission
tracks.summary: Repair the small structures that decide whether a village well lasts past April.
tracks.details: We desilt ponds, rebuild check dams, and reopen blocked nalas with local labour. Volumes are counted from partner measurements, not from a slogan. Drinking water and farm recharge are both in scope.

tracks.title: Green Mobility Survey
tracks.summary: A commute log that asks how people actually move, then pays only for complete, sane entries.
tracks.details: Participants record walk, cycle, bus, and shared rides. The survey is a picture of a neighbourhood, not a gadget challenge. Impossible speeds and copy-paste days are dropped before any reward is considered.

posts.title: What we count after the first monsoon
posts.excerpt: A sapling in a photograph is not a forest. Here is the check we run when the rains leave.
posts.author: Anika Deshmukh
posts.body:
We planted through the hot months on school edges and grazing fallows, then waited. A photo on planting day is the easy record. The record that matters is the one taken when the soil has crusted again.

Ninety days after planting, stewards walk the same line. A living sapling stays in the public count. A dead one is removed, even if the earlier photo was perfect. That subtraction is the whole point of the ledger.

$MYTREE attached to a task waits for the same check. The token does not make a tree real. The walk does.

posts.title: Why donations and tokens do not share a ledger
posts.excerpt: INR gifts fund work. $MYTREE purchases are a separate, risk-bearing sale. Mixing them helps nobody.
posts.author: Kabir Sethi
posts.body:
A family that gives five hundred rupees is not joining a referral scheme. Their gift is recorded as a donation, receipted if they leave an email, and kept out of the token contract.

A wallet that buys $MYTREE is doing something else. The price is set in the admin panel, mirrored on-chain, and the purchase can fail, pause, or lose value. Referral bonuses apply only there, and only after the transaction confirms.

If a page ever implies that a donation earns tokens, that page is wrong. Tell us, and we will correct the copy.
